row.title: Land a stale-base round by three-way applying its delta onto main
row.body: Round 2 of the spec run was built on a base far behind main. Rebasing its 340-file snapshot would have replayed stale history, so its delta (base to snapshot, minus test-run ledgers) was applied with git apply --3way onto a fresh worktree at origin/main. Of the 19 conflicts, generated files (READMEs, claims data, papers, self and research data, conformance manifest) were cleared to main and regenerated from the merged tree; hand-merged files kept main's newer behaviour and added round 2's on top (goals.js keeps ASHBY-KERNEL-1 and adds the US-26-R78 burn page; the halt test keeps main's kit-and-platform body and runs in the standalone seed again). A round-2 test written before PR-NEVER-LOSE-1 was brought up to it instead of weakening the guard. Evidence: seed Worker tests 1122, 0 fail, all pass (and 964 pass, 0 fail in a seed-only copy); workers core and packs 2136 pass, 0 fail; seed Python 155 tests pass; 246 foundation test files, 2116 tests, 0 fail apart from three already red on pristine main (actions-budget.json schema); every named foundation check passes.
